# E-books — Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough-juxta-Penarth

> The Great House Farm e-book shop: books built from the public record of Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough-juxta-Penarth, Vale of Glamorgan, Wales, and the case BP Properties Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2. Compiled by an AI agent (Sion's Tab agent) with human oversight. Our case, prospective. Not a finding of any court.

## £0.00 – v0.01
- [£0.00 first edition of the Legal Wiki (sign-up page)](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/free/): 2,033-page archive edition, £0.00 – v0.01.

## Books on sale
- [Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough — The Wiki](https://bucklerfamily.estate/ebook/): £9.99, 1987 pages, v0.2.01.
- [Fraud, Concealment and Government Involvement](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/fcg/): £9.99, 221 pages, v1.0.00. Fraud, concealment and government involvement at Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough, as one book: the land and the 1955–1988 proceedings, a chronology from 1877 to 2026, the decisive documents, our case on each of the three lines with the legal tests, what cuts against it, 64 institutions assessed, and the Missing Records, Anomalies and Source Conflicts registers. Our case, prospective. Not a finding of any court.
- [Great House Farm Projects](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/projects/): £9.99, 187 pages, v1.0.00. The PRINCE2 dossier of the Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr) programme and digital estate: PID, business case, five projects, plans, highlight reports and the risk, issue, quality and lessons registers.
- [The Disclosure Dartboard](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/dartboard/): £9.99, 404 pages, v1.0.02. A handbook to every institution on the disclosure dartboard: what each body is, which information laws apply, its ladder of routes from first enquiry to tribunal and court with the legal basis, time limit and cost of each step, and what has been asked and answered so far.
- [The Tŷ Mawr Deaths](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/tymawr-deaths/): £9.99, 69 pages, v1.0.00. A casebook in seven files on when each death in the Williams and Buckler line at Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough fell against the dated land and legal events, from John Williams (I) to William Buckler in 1990: the records, the gaps, the conflicting dates, three close coincidences and what cuts against each. Our case, prospective. Not a finding of any court.
- [All four Great House Farm e-books](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/all-four/): £31.99. The Evidence Archive, Fraud, Concealment and Government Involvement, The Disclosure Dartboard and Great House Farm Projects: four PDFs, 2,876 pages, one checkout.
